description: Conversion of the garage into habitable room and replacement of the garage door with a window, erection of  first floor side extension and  a single storey rear extension, enlargement of the existing roof extension, and one additional front roof window to the house. Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding in the rear garden of the house.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [1102 AL(05)1151 Rev 00, Design Access/Heritage Statement, 1102 AL(02)1050 Rev 00, 1102 AL(02)1001 Rev 01, 1102AL(08)2120 Rev 00, Flood risk assessment, 1102AL(02)1011 Rev 00, 1102AL(02)1010 Rev 00, 1102AL(05)1150 Rev 04, 1102AL(04)1101 Rev 05, 1102AL(04)1111 Rev 01 received 18/02/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the '26 Grove Park Road, Chiswick, W4 3SD' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 5 - The window(s) to be fitted on the [front/rear] roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural and historic interest of the [conservation area/listed building].
